test_modes.name: Wake-up / COM-rate test
test_modes.purpose: Verify the wake-up request switches SIO->SDCI and the Master detects COM1/COM2/COM3.

test_modes.name: M-sequence capture / decode
test_modes.purpose: Capture the C/Q UART traffic and decode M-sequences for bring-up.

test_modes.name: ISDU read/write test
test_modes.purpose: Exercise ISDU Index/Subindex parameter access and segmentation.

test_modes.name: Checksum error injection
test_modes.purpose: Inject CKT/CKS errors to confirm detection and retry.

test_modes.name: Event test
test_modes.purpose: Trigger Device Events and confirm the Master reads them.

test_debug_features: Internal loopback (MCR.LOOP=1) for fault isolation; SOUT internally drives SIN; modem outputs drive modem inputs.
Break, parity, overrun, framing error simulation through loopback + register manipulation.
FIFO reset bits (FCR.RX_FIFO_RESET, FCR.TX_FIFO_RESET) for in-chip BIST equivalent.
Complete LSR status reporting allows software self-test of all framing / error paths.
Master Reset (MR pin) sets a known reset state per Table I.

spec_provided_observability.name: CKT/CKS checksum
spec_provided_observability.purpose: Per-M-sequence integrity check; a mismatch flags a corrupted message.

spec_provided_observability.name: Device status octet
spec_provided_observability.purpose: Observable Device status and Event flag in each response.

spec_provided_observability.name: Events
spec_provided_observability.purpose: EventCode + EventQualifier carry diagnostics (error / warning / notification).

spec_provided_observability.name: Direct Parameter page
spec_provided_observability.purpose: Identification and communication parameters readable during STARTUP.

interrupt_sources.trigger: RX data available or FIFO trigger level reached.
Character timeout — RX FIFO non-empty + no new char within 4 character times.

interrupt_request: INTR pin (active HIGH) is the OR of all enabled interrupt sources; IIR identifies the highest-priority pending source.
notes: IO-Link's protocol-level observability is the per-character even parity, the per-M-sequence CKT/CKS checksum, the Device status octet, the Event mechanism, and the Direct Parameter page. Chip-level JTAG/scan/BIST remain Device/SoC-integrator concerns.
error_detection_mechanisms: Even parity bit per UART character detects single-bit errors.
CKT/CKS checksum per M-sequence detects message corruption.
Response timeout detects a non-responding Device.
Repeated failure causes fallback to SIO and a communication-lost Event.

interrupt_or_event_sources.trigger: A cyclic Process Data exchange completed (CKS pass).
Repeated timeout/checksum failure; fallback to SIO.
